attempts.summary: Set up a one-way sync (node1 → node2) of /etc/inventory/app.conf using SSH-key-authenticated rsync driven by a cron job on node2 (every 5 minutes, well under the 15-minute requirement). Fixed node1's non-functioning sshd (missing host keys) to enable the SSH path. Verified the sync detects and propagates real changes automatically, and confirmed both nodes survive independent restarts (new boot IDs) with the sync mechanism and data fully recovered afterward.
